method: Main reviewed all 29 review-view rows, then source and raw for order-sensitive cases. These are registered finite properties, not 29 independent tasks or full response fidelity.

otherRegisteredCasesDisposition: Named finite scalar/binding/return-boundary properties agree; missing endpoint proof and full response conversion still prevent whole-task completeness.
